newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sawn goods demand improving, paper may follow - UPM.
newsitem.headline: Sawn goods demand improving, paper may follow - UPM.

text.p: Some sawn goods prices have now turned higher, demand may keep rising and this may be followed by an upturn in demand for paper products, said UPM-Kymmene Oy chief financial officer Jan-Henrik Kulp.
"Spruce sawn goods prices have started to turn (higher). I have the impression that demand will be rising," he told Reuters on Thursday.
Normally, demand for pulp and various paper products followed sawn goods demand with a lag of four to 12 months, he said.
"If we see good news from sawn goods, which is my guess...and if the old correlation is valid, in a few months it should be seen in paper products," Kulp told a seminar.
UPN-Kymmene is Europe's biggest forest industry group.
